scenicChapters.title: Paso de los Libertadores
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 3832 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Portillo and Los Libertadores
scenicChapters.narrative: 3832 m come off over 102 km at around 6.2%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

paso-de-los-libertadores.story: From Mendoza it runs 412 km to Los Andes; allow about 5 h 38 of riding. It goes by way of Potrerillos, Uspallata, Puente del Inca and Cristo Redentor Pass. The highest point is about 4,050 m. Cristo Redentor Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It crosses from Argentina into Chile - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
